import json,collections
items=list(map(json.loads,open('items.jsonl')))
rows=list(map(json.loads,open('answers.jsonl')))
rows[18]['slots']['1']='ь'
rows[80]['confidence']['3']='high'
rows[80]['note']='Top flag remains visible despite worn bowl.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
checked=list(map(json.loads,open('answers.jsonl')))
assert len(checked)==len(items)
for item,row in zip(items,checked):
 assert row['item_id']==item['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,item['slots']+1)}
 assert set(row['slots'])==expected
 assert set(row['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in {'ъ','ь','other','u'} for v in row['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in {'high','low'} for v in row['confidence'].values())
 assert row['pre1918'] in {'yes','no','unclear'}
 assert isinstance(row['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
counts=collections.Counter(v for r in checked for v in r['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(checked),'items;',sum(counts.values()),'slots')
print(dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(r['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for r in checked))
